# Nested If Statement

A nested `if` statement is an `if` statement inside another conditional. Use a nested `if` statement when your app needs to check one condition first, then check another condition inside that path.
name: Nested If Statement
tips:
- Use a nested `if` statement when one condition depends on another condition.
- Keep each `if` and `else` pair inside curly braces `{ }`.
- Make sure each opening `{` has a matching closing `}`.
- Use indentation to make nested conditionals easier to read.
- In Web Lab, nested `if` statements are often used when an app checks two related choices or states.
